description: This Java class defines the StatusDetailMessage, which encapsulates a status level (INFO, WARN, ERROR) and an associated message, with serialization and deserialization support to/from JSON. It appears to be used for representing detailed status messages in a health check context within the service's utility package.

classes.name: StatusDetailMessage
classes.description: A class representing a detailed status message with a severity level and message content.

classes.name: StatusDetailMessage.Level
classes.description: Enumeration of status levels: INFO, WARN, ERROR, with a default of INFO.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a StatusDetailMessage with a specified level and message string.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Creates a warning message from an optional Throwable.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the StatusDetailMessage to a JsonObject.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JsonObject into a StatusDetailMessage, expecting exactly one field indicating level and message.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level of the status message.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message content as a JsonValue.
